name: Jouki no Machi no Kaikitan
source:
Set in a fictional western city of the 20th century, a novice detective works hard with some mysterious bouncers to solve the case. There are no non-human things living in the city. We hope you enjoy the world of steampunk.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/6261]NovelGame[/url]]
